<!-- Title is required in GitHub's issue title field, which represents the contract's Title section. Write one plain-language line with no ticket-speak or trailing punctuation; it must stand alone when copied verbatim into a pull request's Bugs Discovered list. Do not add a Title heading or an agent-disclosure footer to this body. -->

<!-- Repository sponsor: state what finishes this issue in a comment, not in this body. Post one comment that starts with the exact, case-sensitive words "Done when" before the issue is first assigned, and leave it unedited after that, for example: Done when `pnpm test --run tests/foo.test.ts` passes and `pnpm lint` is clean. Overflow shows contributors the earliest such comment as untrusted input. -->

## Description

<!-- Required. Keep this section. Describe observed behavior only: what is actually wrong. Do not include a fix, cause, or hypothesis. If reproduction is unreliable, say so here. -->

## Expected Behavior

<!-- Required. Keep this section. State what should happen instead. -->

## Reproduction Steps

<!-- Conditional: always check whether the behavior is reliably reproducible. Keep this section only when it is; otherwise delete the heading and this comment and note the unreliability in Description. When included, use a numbered list of complete steps that trigger the behavior. -->

## Environment / Context

<!-- Optional. Keep this section only when version, operating system, configuration, or data conditions matter; otherwise delete the heading and this comment. -->

## Discovered During

<!-- Required. Keep this section. Link or identify the pull request, task, or session that surfaced the issue. If there is no pull request, cite the task or session rather than omitting this section. -->

## Suggested Fix

<!-- Optional. Keep this section only when a hypothesis or useful pointer exists; otherwise delete the heading and this comment. Clearly mark any suggestion as unverified. A suggested fix never replaces the observed-behavior Description. -->
